ProxyPin resource preview: libmpv and FFmpeg

ProxyPin uses libmpv through package:media_kit to decode resource thumbnails
and inspect media information. ProxyPin's own source remains licensed under
Apache License 2.0. The third-party shared library has its own licenses.

The selected Windows x64 libmpv binary is the upstream media-kit LGPL build
published on 2024-10-21, built with mpv -Dgpl=false and FFmpeg --disable-gpl,
--disable-nonfree, --enable-version3. It is distributed under LGPL-3.0-or-later
because it includes FFmpeg built with version 3 enabled. mpv itself is
LGPL-2.1-or-later in this configuration. The package:media_kit Dart API is MIT.

mpv copyright belongs to the mpv, MPlayer and mplayer2 contributors.
FFmpeg copyright belongs to the FFmpeg contributors. Source file headers and
the upstream repositories identify individual authors and copyright notices.
These libraries are provided without warranty; see the enclosed license texts.

License texts:
  COPYING.LGPL-3.0.txt
  COPYING.GPL-3.0.txt (the GPL text incorporated by LGPL version 3)
  COPYING.LGPL-2.1.txt
  MPV-COPYRIGHT.txt
  FFMPEG-LICENSE.txt
  MEDIA-KIT-LICENSE.txt

libmpv-2.dll is loaded dynamically from the executable's directory. You may
replace it with an interface-compatible modified build. Build-time download
hashes do not prevent loading your modified DLL at runtime. No term in
ProxyPin's license restricts modification of this library or reverse
engineering of the application to debug such modifications.

Pinned source, binary provenance and build instructions are in SOURCES.md.
Additional library dependencies and their source/license references are listed
in DEPENDENCIES.md. Keep this directory with every redistributed binary.
